programme.title: Pride and Prejudice
programme.desc: Elizabeth Bennet is a hard-working, intelligent college student who won't even think about marriage until she graduates. But when she meets Jack Wickham, a good-looking playboy, and Darcy, a sensible businessman, Elizabeth's determination is put to the test. Will she see through their exteriors and discover their true intentions? Based on Jane Austen's timeless tale Pride and Prejudice.

programme.title: Inspiring Love
programme.desc: Shy artist Isla is shocked when her painting is accidentally sold to charismatic salesman Mark, whose boss wants to comission Isla for a sculpture. Mark, hoping to impress his boss, talks Isla up and gets her to do the job, but there's one problem...Isla's never sculpted before. With Mark's encouragement, Isla's confidence blossoms and so does their love.

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauty Next Door
programme.desc: A woman with a condition that causes her to fall asleep when feeling strong emotions falls in love with her new neighbor. Will she be able to stay awake to make her dreams a reality?

programme.title: You’re So Cupid
programme.desc: Fraternal twin sisters Emma and Lilly are as different as night and day but both have an insatiable desire to play matchmaker. Why? Because their father is actually Cupid! Life gets complicated when they discover they're in love with the same guy and they become bitter rivals as they try to win his affection. But can Emma and Lily overcome their problems and use their matchmaking skills to bring their divorcing parents back together?
